stories.story_fr: La prise de commandes a augmenté de 12 % pour atteindre 36 756 MSEK.
stories.story_en: Order intake grew 12% to SEK 36,756 million.
stories.quote: Total order intake increased by 12% compared to last year and amounted to SEK 36,756 million (32,763).

stories.story_fr: L'EBITA ajusté a progressé de 6 % pour atteindre 6 138 MSEK, avec une marge de 20,0 %.
stories.story_en: Adjusted EBITA rose 6% to SEK 6,138 million, margin 20.0%.
stories.quote: Adjusted EBITA increased by 6% and amounted to SEK 6,138 million (5,768).

stories.story_fr: Le flux de trésorerie opérationnel libre a baissé de 5 % à 3 613 MSEK.
stories.story_en: Free operating cash flow fell 5% to SEK 3,613 million.
stories.quote: Free operating cash flow amounted to SEK 3,613 million (3,809).
